saw_lines: Shoppers buying supplements online compare price per pack across sellers, then reorder the same brand without rereading the label.
So the sale is won on the price and the free shipping threshold, before a buyer ever opens the cart.
Your site leads with free shipping over $125 and 750,000 customers served, but no Meta ads run yet, so build the first paid creative around both.
ads_1: Google search creative leading with the discount pricing your homepage already shows
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
